description: Live shipping prices from Global Shopaholics' US warehouse (Delaware) to a destination country, for DHL, FedEx, UPS and USPS services. Returns each service's USD price, transit time, max weight/size, insurance terms and whether dimensional weight applies, sorted cheapest first. Prices exclude import duties/taxes. Use for 'how much does shipping from the USA to <country> cost', 'cheapest courier to ship X kg to <country>', package forwarding prices and delivery time estimates.

city.description: Destination city. Defaults to the capital GS's calculator uses.

country.description: Destination country: ISO 2-letter code (AO, SA, AE, GB, NG...) or name ('Angola').

length.description: Box length (cm if kg, in if lb). Optional; improves accuracy because dimensional weight applies.

unit.description: Unit for weight. Dimensions use cm with kg, inches with lb.

weight.description: Package weight (0.1–275 in the chosen unit; decimals OK). Use the expected consolidated box weight.

zip.description: Destination postal code. Defaults to the calculator's capital zip (00000 where none).

name: get_shipping_rates
title: International shipping cost from the US (live DHL/FedEx/UPS/USPS rates)
